name: bol_retail_media-mcp
description: bol Retail Media (Sponsored Products) (ads): me, list_campaigns, get_report. Every tool maps to a do

platform_mcp_bol_retail_media_client_id.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BOL_RETAIL_MEDIA_CLIENT_ID
platform_mcp_bol_retail_media_client_id.description: Client id of bol API credentials with Advertising API access (seller dashboard > Settings > API settings, or intermediary authorization for agencies); exchanged at POST https://login.bol.com/token (grant_type=client_credentials, HTTP Basic) for a ~5-minute JWT.

platform_mcp_bol_retail_media_client_sec.title: PLATFORM_MCP_BOL_RETAIL_MEDIA_CLIENT_SECRET
platform_mcp_bol_retail_media_client_sec.description: The matching client secret. The JWT is cached and re-requested before expiry (bol bans IPs that request a token per call).

tools.name: me
tools.description: There is no account endpoint; the probe is GET /advertiser/sponsored-products/budget-management/budget-settings ({mode: BASIC|ADVANCED}), which verifies the JWT has Advertising API access.

tools.name: list_campaigns
tools.description: POST /advertiser/sponsored-products/campaign-management/campaigns/list {filter: {states: [status]}, page, pageSize (≤100)}. status is ENABLED, PAUSED or ARCHIVED. `budget` is the daily budget in EUR (totalBudget, campaignType AUTO|MANUAL, targetCountries NL/BE and constraints such as OUT_OF_DAILY_BUDGET in raw). `account_id` is not sent (the JWT selects the retailer account).

tools.name: get_report
tools.description: GET /advertiser/sponsored-products/reporting/performance?entity-type=CAMPAIGN&entity-ids=<campaign_id>&period-start-date&period-end-date: one aggregated row for the campaign over the period (dates within the last 30 days, inclusive). campaign_id is REQUIRED (entity-ids is mandatory; the account-level /performance/advertiser returns a single total, not rows). cost in EUR; conversions and sales are 14-day attributed.
